title: Discovery of Dihydro-1,4-Benzoxazine Carboxamides as Potent and Highly Selective Inhibitors of Sirtuin-1.
authors: Spinck, Martin; Bischoff, Matthias; Lampe, Philipp; Meyer-Almes, Franz-Josef; Sievers, Sonja; Neumann, Heinz
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子抑制剂与Sirtuin-1蛋白的相互作用，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Sirtuins are signaling hubs orchestrating the cellular response to various stressors with roles in all major civilization diseases. Sirtuins remove acyl groups from lysine residues of proteins, thereby controlling their activity, turnover, and localization. The seven human sirtuins, SirT1-7, are closely related in structure, hindering the development of specific inhibitors. Screening 170,000 compounds, we identify and optimize SirT1-specific benzoxazine inhibitors, Sosbo, which rival the efficiency and surpass the selectivity of selisistat (EX527). The compounds inhibit the deacetylation of p53 in cultured cells, demonstrating their ability to permeate biological membranes. Kinetic analysis of inhibition and docking studies reveal that the inhibitors bind to a complex of SirT1 and nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, similar to selisistat. These new SirT1 inhibitors are valuable alternatives to selisistat in biochemical and cell biological studies. Their greater selectivity may allow the development of better targeted drugs to combat SirT1 activity in diseases such as cancer, Huntington's chorea, or anorexia.
abstract_zh: Sirtuins是信号枢纽，协调细胞对各种应激源的反应，并在所有主要文明病中发挥作用。Sirtuins从蛋白质的赖氨酸残基上移除酰基，从而控制其活性、周转和定位。七种人类sirtuins，SirT1-7，在结构上密切相关，这阻碍了特异性抑制剂的开发。通过筛选170,000种化合物，我们识别并优化了SirT1特异性的苯并噁嗪抑制剂Sosbo，其效率可与selisistat (EX527)相媲美，且选择性更优。这些化合物抑制培养细胞中p53的去乙酰化，展示了它们穿透生物膜的能力。抑制动力学分析和对接研究表明，这些抑制剂结合到SirT1与烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸的复合物上，类似于selisistat。这些新型SirT1抑制剂在生物化学和细胞生物学研究中是selisistat的宝贵替代品。它们更高的选择性可能有助于开发更精准靶向的药物，以对抗癌症、亨廷顿舞蹈症或厌食症等疾病中的SirT1活性。
